claim_under_attack.claim_text: Superseding KPIs report group-safe-split headline numbers with applicability-domain gating; VK Ridge refit is scope-limited to well-supported groups without sign flips.

d1_group_safe_headline.summary: Group-safe macro-bisection headline for density/refractive_index/thermal_conductivity (all REFUTED vs 2x bar); random-split numbers demoted to reference; static_dielectric_const excluded (label inadmissibility, already retracted). Fidelity of the superseding table verified against a genuine planted-defect positive control.

d2_ad_gate.summary: AD gate (Tanimoto NN-distance threshold, per-training-set CV/LOO calibrated, OR training-label-range check) demonstrated on all 4 C7 failing legs (tg_A, tg_B, density_A, density_B). All 4 meet the pre-registered >=90% abstention-on-failing-transfer / >=90% within-corpus-coverage bar: abstention 93.75-100%, coverage 90.0-93.75%. Positive control (tau disabled -> 1.1) collapses abstention to 0.0% on all 4 legs. Demonstration only; not wired into any shipped serving predictor code path.

d3_constrained_vk_refit.summary: NNLS-constrained Ridge refit on the 10 groups with n_train>=500 (CH2, CH3, CH, C_quat, vinyl_CH, ether_O, primary_amine, secondary_amine, tertiary_amine, epoxide). Zero sign flips (guaranteed by construction). Test MAE 21.35 K vs same-sample published-baseline 216.60 K and original reference baseline 54.56 K -- both acceptance criteria met.

objective: R-C03, three deliverables across three fires: (1) SUPERSEDING multi-target KPI under the macro-bisection group-safe split; (2) AD GATE on Tg/density predictors demonstrated on the C7 failing legs; (3) CONSTRAINED VK REFIT via NNLS scope-limited to n_train>=500 groups, no sign flips by construction.

positive_control.evidence: sign_flip_check on the real fitted table found [] (must be empty -- claim survives); the SAME check re-run on the planted copy found ['secondary_amine'] (must be non-empty -- detector fires)
positive_control.how_planted: planted_coef[9] (secondary_amine) = -abs(best_coef[9]) = -5315.3006378574055, all other 9 coefficients left at their real NNLS-fitted values
positive_control.note: d2 (AD gate) carries an independent positive control of its own (tau disabled -> 1.1 collapses abstention to 0.0% on all 4 legs; see d2 receipt f65438b9f88740b358607ccddbc12675c522146700028c0ed27f364305ad3048). Reproduced here verbatim for the consolidated receipt's own self-contained positive_control field, per the done_criterion requirement.
positive_control.planted_defect: negated the largest-magnitude fitted NNLS coefficient (group=secondary_amine) in a COPY of the fitted table, simulating the kind of sign-inadmissible coefficient the acceptance check (criterion_1) exists to catch

pre_registered_acceptance_stated_numeric.d1_group_safe_split_protocol: reused verbatim from evidence/audit/multitarget-macro-bisection-external-validity-w7-v1/ (the refuting receipt's own protocol)
pre_registered_acceptance_stated_numeric.d2_abstention_target: >=90% abstention on the 4 C7 failing legs -- observed 93.75-100%
pre_registered_acceptance_stated_numeric.d3_MAE_target: test MAE <= published Y_gi baseline MAE -- observed 21.35 K <= 216.60 K (same test sample) and <= 54.56 K (original KPI reference baseline)
pre_registered_acceptance_stated_numeric.d3_sign_flip_target: 0 fitted Y_gi with sign opposite published, among in-scope (n_train>=500) groups -- observed 0/10 (guaranteed by NNLS construction)

reviewer_reference.note: Reviewer key referenced for provenance only; no independent human review performed.

rights_check: No new data source opened this fire beyond the already-rights-cleared, already-hash-pinned Polyuniverse Epoxy CSV cited by the original KPI. Consolidation reads only already-in-tree, already-signed artifacts.

signing_key.used_for: AUDIT_ONLY R-C03 consolidated done receipt under evidence/phase0/repairs/R-C03/done/

supersedes.reason: Deliverable 1: the within-corpus 60/20/20-random-split headline (refractive_index R2=+0.893, thermal_conductivity R2=+0.542) is demoted to within-corpus reference; the macro-bisection group-safe-split numbers (all REFUTED vs the 2x external-validity bar; static_dielectric_const excluded for label inadmissibility) are published as the new headline. See deliverable-1 receipt for the full per-leg table.

Deliverable 3: replaces the unconstrained 24-group Ridge fit (2/24 sign-reversed coefficients per W8) with a non-negative-least-squares (NNLS) refit scope-limited to the 10 groups with n_train_polymers_with_group>=500 in the ORIGINAL KPI's own table. No sign flip is possible by construction. Test MAE 21.35 K beats both the same-sample published-baseline MAE (216.60 K) and the original KPI's own reference baseline (54.56 K).

why: All three pre-registered R-C03 deliverables landed and each independently meets its numeric acceptance bar: (1) group-safe-split headline numbers published, superseding the random-split-only multitarget KPI; (2) an AD gate demonstrated >=90% abstention on known C7 failing transfers while retaining >=90% within-corpus coverage, on all 4 legs; (3) a constrained (NNLS) VK Ridge refit scope-limited to well-supported groups produces zero sign flips by construction and beats the published Y_gi baseline on test MAE. This consolidated receipt ties the three deliverable-level receipts together and supersedes the two most concretely nameable original KPIs (multi-target-ml-radonpy-4-properties-audit-kpi.v1.json and van-krevelen-ridge-fit-on-1000-polyuniverse-polymers-kpi.v1.json) by sha256, per the done_criterion's supersedes requirement.
